title: Lineage manifest — the conductor's discovery of how one target is built

build_sites.description: Every place in the repo that writes the target, in execution order where known.

role.description: e.g. final INSERT/MERGE, CREATE VIEW, saveAsTable, orchestration step

shape.description: e.g. Teradata BTEQ, Databricks SQL notebook, PySpark spark.sql, Jinja-templated SQL

columns.description: Every column of the target, in the target's own order. Exhaustive.

defined_at.description: where this column's output expression is written

expression.description: the output expression as written, if short

object_index.description: Intermediate objects (temp/volatile tables, CTEs, views, DataFrames) the build reads or creates, with where each is defined. A head start for tracers.

templating.description: How names are resolved when they are not literal: config files, env vars, Jinja/f-string params, and the values you resolved.

notes.description: Anything a tracer should know before starting: gotchas, ordering, dead ends already hit.
